text:
Tara: Quick heads up — new hire Naomi Park lands Sun 20:10 and wants to start Mon. Checkr status: 'Pending — identity docs requested'. I-9 slot was Mon 10:00 but security desk staffing ends 18:30 so same-day badge pickup after hours won't work. Any thoughts? :thinking_face:
Emily: Can we swap the I-9 to Monday 08:15? Or arrange a Sunday mobile notary/courier pickup if candidate can meet (candidate pays for notary ideally).
Raj: If passport scan is in Checkr it usually clears fast. I can cover 08:15 verification. @Security-Team can reception issue temp pass for morning?
Security-Team: We can issue a temporary visitor pass at reception for 08:00 arrival. Full badge requires BG clearance. Need photo + name at desk.
Lena-Courier: I can pick up docs at Terminal 3 up to ~23:00 Sun. Will accept only with written consent and copy of candidate ID. Ops or courier fee applies.
Tara: DM'ing Naomi to confirm consent and pickup time.
Emily: If courier collects Sun, Ops will deliver docs to Kiosk A Mon 07:30 so Raj can verify before security shift ends. Need someone from Ops to accompany handoff.
Raj: I'll be there for 08:15. @Security-Team please confirm escort and temp pass.
People-ops-bot: Naomi Park submitted DocuSign I-9 consent. Checkr link: https://checkr.example/naomi (candidate id 78901).
Mike: IT update — Naomi's laptop delayed to Mon AM. I'll secure it at reception labelled "NAOMI PARK - HOLD" and hand to Raj after I-9 verification.
Emily: Day-1 checklist:
- 08:00 Naomi arrival, temp visitor pass from reception
- 08:15 I-9 verification (Raj)
- 08:45 Laptop handoff (Mike)
- 09:15 Manager 1:1 + orientation kickoff
- Badge issued after BG clearance by Security
Raj: If Checkr flags an issue, fallback = remote-first day + buddy onboarding. @Tara please prep HR escalation template.
Tara: Escalation doc added: https://redwoodhr.docs/onboard/escalation-template. Ping me for urgent review.
Naomi: (candidate) Hi all — I consent to courier pickup. I can meet at Terminal 3 baggage claim at 21:15 Sun. Thanks for the flexibility! :slightly_smiling_face:
Emily: I'll send Naomi the Day-1 itinerary and courier contact. Reserving a hybrid desk in SF-2 for week 1.
People-ops-bot: Thread updated — badge hold placed; kiosk reschedule pending. :white_check_mark:
